title: DIRECTED READING AND WRITING IN SPANISH
description: Emphasizes reading comprehension and improving writing ability. Builds on language skills and cultural awareness using different forms of literary expression from the Spanish-speaking world.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (SPAN 311, 312 and 313) or (SPAN 314, 315 and 316).
A minimum grade of C- is required in SPAN 311, SPAN 312, SPAN 313, SPAN 314, SPAN 315 and SPAN 316.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 8:30am-9:50am in KIDD 278 - Kidder Hall 278 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
